# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m backend.config_reference --write` from backend/config_reference.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting PRKS knows, by where it lives (#612). Browser-local preferences (theme, layout, workspace tabs) stay in each browser and are not listed here. Detailed behavior of each deployment setting is on the wiki's Configuration and Operations page.

Check a deployment before starting it with `python prks_app.py config check`: it validates every setting the way a start does and prints the effective values and where each comes from, with secrets hidden. It reads the data root's path but not the root itself: a start can still refuse a root for its filesystem or its contents.

## Deployment (environment)

Set in the host's environment, Compose `.env` or a secret file, by whoever runs PRKS. Read once at start: a change needs a restart. The browser can never change them. An invalid value stops the process with exit status 2; nothing falls back to a default.

| Key | Read by | Default | Secret | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PRKS_STORAGE` | `serve`, `migrate`, `worker` | data/ (testing: data_testing/) | no | The data root: managed PDFs, portraits, thumbnails and the root marker. |
| `PRKS_CONFIG_FILE` | `serve`, `migrate`, `worker`, `admin` | the platform configuration directory | no | Path of the bootstrap configuration file; its directory also holds the bootstrap-token file. Ignored in testing mode. |
| `PRKS_DATABASE_URL` | `serve`, `migrate`, `worker`, `admin` | none (testing: the scripts/dev-postgres server) | yes | PostgreSQL connection string. Set this or PRKS_DATABASE_URL_FILE. |
| `PRKS_DATABASE_URL_FILE` | `serve`, `migrate`, `worker`, `admin` | unset | no | File holding the connection string (a Compose secret). Preferred. |
| `PRKS_DB_POOL_MAX` | `serve`, `migrate` | 10 | no | Largest connection pool of the web process and of migrate. |
| `PRKS_MIGRATE_ON_START` | `serve` | 1 | no | 1 applies the schema at start; 0 leaves it to migrate and only verifies it. |
| `PRKS_AUTH` | `serve` | session (testing: loopback-owner) | no | session (password sign-in) or loopback-owner (testing on loopback only). |
| `PRKS_EMBEDDED_WORKER` | `serve` | 1 | no | 1 runs a job worker inside the web process; 0 leaves jobs to a worker. |
| `PRKS_HTTP_THREADS` | `serve` | 16 | no | Requests that run PRKS work at the same time, 1 to 256. |
| `PRKS_TLS_CERT_FILE` | `serve` | unset | no | PEM certificate chain; with PRKS_TLS_KEY_FILE PRKS serves HTTPS itself. |
| `PRKS_TLS_KEY_FILE` | `serve` | unset | no | Unencrypted PEM private key for PRKS_TLS_CERT_FILE. |
| `PRKS_PUBLIC_ORIGIN` | `serve` | the request's own origin | no | The origin browsers use behind an HTTPS reverse proxy. |
| `PRKS_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `serve` | none | no | Proxy addresses or networks whose X-Forwarded-For is believed. |
| `PRKS_TRUSTED_HOSTS` | `serve` | none | no | Extra Host header names the server accepts, comma-separated. |
| `PRKS_SESSION_IDLE_DAYS` | `serve` | 30 | no | Days a session stays valid without use, 1 to 365. |
| `PRKS_LOGIN_WINDOW_SECONDS` | `serve` | 900 | no | Length of the sign-in rate-limit window. |
| `PRKS_LOGIN_ACCOUNT_LIMIT` | `serve` | 5 | no | Sign-in attempts per account per window from an unknown device. |
| `PRKS_LOGIN_ADDRESS_LIMIT` | `serve` | 20 | no | Sign-in attempts per client address per window. |
| `PRKS_LOGIN_DEVICE_LIMIT` | `serve` | 5 | no | Sign-in attempts per known sign-in device per window. |
| `PRKS_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN_FILE` | `admin` | unset | no | An owner-only file holding the setup token an installer chose. |
| `PRKS_LOG_LEVEL` | `serve`, `worker` | INFO | no | Stderr log level. |
| `PRKS_LOG_FILE_LEVEL` | `serve` | ERROR | no | Persistent file log level. |
| `PRKS_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` | `serve` | 7 | no | Rotated persistent log copies to keep, 1 to 3650. |
| `PRKS_LOG_FILE` | `serve` | <data root>/prks-errors.log | no | Path of the rotating error log. |
| `PRKS_PERF_SLOW_MS` | `serve` | 250 | no | API request duration counted as slow, 10 to 60000 ms. |
| `PRKS_PERF_LOG_SLOW` | `serve` | off | no | Log a privacy-safe slow_request line for slow API requests. |
| `PRKS_BACKUP_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` | `serve` | 68719476736 (64 GiB) | no | Largest uploaded .prks-backup restore archive, in bytes. |
| `PRKS_PDF_LINEARIZE` | `serve`, `worker` | auto | no | Linearize PDFs on import. Unset: on when qpdf is installed. |
| `PRKS_THUMB_LOSSLESS` | `serve` | off | no | Lossless thumbnail cache encoding (debugging). |

## Compose (`.env`)

Read by `docker-compose.yml` itself; `.env.example` lists them. Never put a password or a database URL in `.env`.

| Key | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `UID` | 1000 | Host user the PRKS containers run as. |
| `GID` | 1000 | Host group the PRKS containers run as. |
| `PRKS_DATA_DIR` | ./data | Host directory mounted at /data as the data root. |
| `PRKS_DB_PASSWORD_FILE` | ./secrets/db_password | Owner-only file with the database password (db only). |
| `PRKS_DB_URL_FILE` | ./secrets/database_url | Owner-only file with the database URL (the prks_database_url secret). |
| `PRKS_PUBLISH_HOST` | 127.0.0.1 | Host address the web port is published on. |
| `PRKS_PUBLISH_PORT` | 8080 | Host port the web port is published on. |

## Library (Settings)

Stored in PostgreSQL per Library and edited in Settings by the Library's owner. A change applies at once and follows the Library in its backups.

| Key | Read by | Default | Secret | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `annotation_author` | Settings | empty | no | Author name written into PDF annotations. |
| `bibtex_export_fields` | Settings | every field | no | Fields included in BibTeX export. |
| `citation_style` | Settings | the built-in default | no | The Library's default citation style. |

## Retired

No longer read. A process that finds one set refuses to start; remove it.

| Key | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `PRKS_LIBRARY_BACKEND` | PostgreSQL is the only Library backend (PG-C2 #641); its database is PRKS_DATABASE_URL. |
| `PRKS_FOR_PROCESSING_DIR` | Files for Processing live in the Library (PG-C2 #641). |

## Internal

Set by PRKS's own tooling (`--testing`, the Docker image, the E2E harness). Not for operators.

| Key | Read by | Default | Secret | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PRKS_TESTING` | `serve`, `migrate`, `worker`, `admin` | off | no | Set by --testing: testing paths, port 8070, stricter checks. |
| `PRKS_CONTAINER` | `serve`, `migrate`, `worker`, `admin` | off | no | Set by the Docker image: tailors dependency-gate advice. |
| `PRKS_E2E` | `serve` | off | no | Browser E2E harness marker. |
| `PRKS_E2E_STARTUP_PROFILE` | `serve` | off | no | Browser E2E startup-phase profiling. |
